title: lagenophora muscicola
intro: Lagenophora muscicola, commonly known as New Zealand button daisy or small daisy bush, is a flowering plant species native to the southern parts of New Zealand. As a traditional medicinal plant, Lagenophora muscicola is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lagenophora muscicola include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Lagenophora muscicola include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
